user_input: Can I email a customer contract to someone outside Acme?
retrieved_contexts:
['17. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I paste a customer contract into an approved AI tool to summarise it?
Yes. Customer contracts are Confidential, and approved AI tools may be used with Confidential data. They may not be used with Restricted data such as customer payment data.', '13. Contacts
HR queries: hr@acme.example. Payroll queries: payroll@acme.example. IT Service Desk: extension 4000.
| Purpose                          | Contact                 |
|----------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Compliance and gift declarations | compliance@acme.example |
| Internal Committee (POSH)        | ic@acme.example         |
| Ethics and whistleblowing        | ethics@acme.example     |
| Security incidents (24x7)        | Extension 4400          |', '1. Scope
This policy applies to all employees, contractors and interns who access Acme Corp systems or data.
It covers company-issued devices, personally owned devices used for work, cloud services, source code, and data in any form, including paper. Third-party vendors with access to Acme data must also comply through their contracts.', '7. Data Classification
Acme data is classified into four levels: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted. Restricted data (for example customer payment data and salary data) may only be shared with named individuals approved by the data owner.

7.1 Classification levels and handling rules

| Level | Examples | Sharing | Storage | Email outside Acme |
| - | - | - | - | - |
| Public | Marketing website, press releases, published blog posts | Anyone | Any approved system | Allowed |
| Internal | Org charts, internal wiki, policies such as this one | All Acme employees and contractors | Approved Acme systems | Not allowed without manager approval |
| Confidential | Customer contracts, source code, product roadmaps, unreleased financials | Employees with a business need | Approved Acme systems; encrypted in transit | Only to parties under NDA, encrypted |
| Restricted | Customer payment data, salary data, government ID numbers, health information | Named individuals approved by the data owner | Restricted-zone systems only; encrypted at rest and in transit | Never |
']
response: Yes, you may email a customer contract to someone outside Acme only if that party is under a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and the email is encrypted. Customer contracts are classified as Confidential data, which permits external sharing solely to parties under an NDA with encryption [1], [4]. Restricted data, such as customer payment data, must never be emailed outside Acme [4].
reference: Customer contracts are Confidential data. They may be emailed outside Acme only to parties under an NDA, and the email must be encrypted.

user_input: I'm a confirmed employee and I'm resigning. How long is my notice period, and what happens to my unused annual leave when I leave?
retrieved_contexts:
['4. Notice Period
4.1 Resignation process
Resignations are submitted in AcmePeople and accepted by the reporting manager. The notice period starts on the day after the resignation is submitted. Annual leave may not be taken during the notice period except with manager approval; unused annual leave is encashed at exit up to 30 days, as described in the Leave Policy.', '18. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I encash unused annual leave while I am still employed?
No. Annual leave is encashed only on exit, up to 30 days. Balances above 10 days lapse on 31 December each year.', "4. Notice Period
The notice period is 60 days for confirmed employees and 30 days for employees still on probation. Notice period buy-out is at the company's discretion.", '4. Annual Leave
4.2 Joiners and leavers
Employees who join part-way through a month accrue leave for that month only if they join on or before the 15th. Employees who leave Acme Corp accrue leave up to their last working day on the same basis. On exit, any accrued but unused annual leave is encashed at basic salary, up to a maximum of 30 days. Leave taken in excess of the accrued balance at exit is recovered from the final settlement.']
response: As a confirmed employee, your notice period is 60 days [3]. Regarding your unused annual leave, it will be encashed at exit up to a maximum of 30 days at basic salary [4]. Please note that annual leave cannot be taken during the notice period unless approved by your manager, and any balance exceeding 30 days does not carry over or get paid out beyond that limit [1], [2].
reference: The notice period is 60 days for confirmed employees. Any accrued but unused annual leave is encashed at exit at basic salary, up to a maximum of 30 days.
